parts.t: Welcome to Mayfair at West Village by Zenterra! This beautifully finished 4 bed, 3 bath townhome is located in one of Langley’s newest and most peaceful communities. Designed for modern living, it features a side-by-side garage with EV charging, forced-air heating, A/C, on-demand hot water, premium KitchenAid appliances, Whirlpool washer/dryer, a stunning Venetian plaster fireplace, and a gas BBQ hookup on the balcony. A standout feature is the front-facing entrance with direct sidewalk access, giving it more of a true home feel. Just minutes from R.E. Mountain Secondary, Langley Events Centre, parks and courts, T&T, Willowbrook Shopping Centre, and the future SkyTrain. OPEN HOUSE SATURDAY OCTOBER 17 1PM - 3PM.

v: 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, Venetian plaster fireplace, KitchenAid appliances, Whirlpool washer/dryer, forced-air heating and air conditioning.
Side-by-side double garage with EV charging.
